Saturday Club

Terms of Service

Effective November 19, 2026

These terms govern your use of Saturday Club, the college football pick’em app on 4thandsoul.com. By using the service, you agree to these terms and the league rules communicated by your commissioner. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

1. A game among friends

Saturday Club is for friendly competition and entertainment. The service does not accept wagers, collect entry fees, process payments, or provide cash prizes. Point spreads are used to score picks; they are not an invitation to gamble or advice to place a bet.

You must be legally able to agree to these terms. If you need permission from a parent or legal guardian under applicable law, obtain that permission before using the service.

2. Invitations and your account

A valid invitation is required to create an account. Invitations are intended for the person the commissioner invited; do not sell or redistribute them. Google or Facebook sign-in, when enabled, does not replace the invitation requirement for new members.

Provide accurate account information, keep your password and recovery links private, and use your own account. You are responsible for activity you authorize through your account. Tell your commissioner promptly if you believe someone has accessed it without permission. Do not share passwords, sign-in sessions, or password-reset links.

3. Picks, scoring, and league decisions

Your commissioner chooses the weekly slate and manages league access. You may choose which available games to pick. Save your picks before kickoff; a game locks when it starts. A saved pick that covers earns 1 point, a push earns 0.5 points, and a miss or no pick earns 0 points. Canceled or void games earn no points.

Published spreads normally stay fixed. A commissioner may explicitly correct a published spread before kickoff; existing picks then use the corrected line, with a notice on the game card. Review your picks before games begin. Final results determine official standings; live standings are projections that may change.

Scores, schedules, spreads, and game details may be delayed, unavailable, or incorrect. Commissioners may correct game information and results, which can change standings. Raise scoring disputes or suspected errors with your commissioner. The service does not guarantee that a late or unsaved pick can be recovered.

4. Fair play and acceptable use

Respect other members. Do not impersonate anyone, manipulate picks or results without authorization, harass others, send unsolicited invitations, or use the service for unlawful activity. Do not attempt to access another member’s private information, bypass access controls, disrupt the service, or misuse its APIs.

Commissioners and site operators may restrict or suspend access for misuse, security concerns, or league administration. Disabling access can preserve existing picks and historical standings.

5. Privacy and third-party services

Our Privacy & security page explains the account and league information we store, how it is used, security controls, and how to request deletion. Your league name, results, and standings are visible to league members.

The service uses third-party hosting, email, sign-in, and sports-data providers. Their services may be subject to separate terms and privacy policies. Team names and logos identify the teams and remain the property of their respective owners; their appearance does not imply endorsement of Saturday Club.

6. Availability and responsibility

We aim to keep the service useful and reliable, but it is provided “as is” and “as available.” To the extent permitted by applicable law, we do not promise uninterrupted access, error-free data, or that every device, network, or third-party provider will work at all times.

To the extent permitted by applicable law, the service’s operators are not responsible for losses caused by outages, delayed or incorrect sports information, or picks that were not successfully saved. Nothing in these terms excludes rights or liability that applicable law does not allow to be excluded.

7. Changes and leaving the league

Features, providers, and these terms may change. Updated terms will be posted on this page with a revised effective date. Review them when they change; continuing to use the service after the updated terms take effect means you accept them.

You may stop using the service at any time. To request account deletion or removal of a connected sign-in provider, follow the account deletion instructions. Deletion can affect historical standings.

8. Questions or support

Contact your league commissioner through the person or channel that sent your invitation. For account, privacy, security, or terms questions, the commissioner can coordinate with the site operator. Never include your password or a recovery link in a support message.
